slice: D2 - outdoor, garden, pets and cars

ideas.name: Refillable Solitary-Bee Nest Block
ideas.concept: Birch-plywood and clay nest block with replaceable paper nesting tubes sold as annual refills, built to the scientific critiques of cheap bee hotels.
ideas.target_customer: Nordic and DK garden owners who want wildlife-friendly gardens and gift buyers.
ideas.problem_solved: Typical bee hotels are poorly designed and become parasite traps because tubes cannot be cleaned or replaced.
ideas.trend_evidence: Wildlife gardening is called mainstream in 2026 trend roundups; bee-safe.eu says bee hotels are very popular but often bad, which is the gap. No Google Trends breakout data verified.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Science-based tube geometry and cleanable design with entomologist endorsement; annual refill tubes lock in repeat purchase.
ideas.tooling_needed: None beyond laser-cut/CNC jigs, under EUR 500

ideas.name: Windowsill Microgreens Kit with Hemp Refill Mats
ideas.concept: Compact ceramic or recycled tray with reusable lid plus compostable hemp grow mats and seed packs shipped as refills, tuned for low Nordic winter light.
ideas.target_customer: Apartment dwellers in Stockholm, Copenhagen and Malmo who want fresh greens indoors.
ideas.problem_solved: Small-space food growing is hard in dark winters; existing kits are plastic, one-off and messy.
ideas.trend_evidence: AP ran a 2026 spotlight on microgardening from windowsills and balconies; 2026 garden roundups cite kitchen-garden growth. Search-volume data not verified.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Daylight-based placement guide from building-industry experience, branded seed and mat refills, design-led tray.
ideas.price_point_eur: 29-35 (refill packs 9-12 need bundling to stay above 15)
ideas.tooling_needed: Stock tray with custom print, or small ceramic mould under EUR 1k; seed phytosanitary/marketing rules to check

ideas.name: Nordic Native Pollinator Seed Tins
ideas.concept: Three region-specific wildflower seed mixes (meadow, balcony pot, hedge edge) in tin or paper packaging with a sowing calendar and Swedish/Danish provenance.
ideas.target_customer: Garden and balcony owners following rewilding and pollinator trends.
ideas.problem_solved: Generic wildflower mixes include non-native species and give little guidance for Nordic climate.
ideas.trend_evidence: Native planting and gardening for pollinators and birds are repeatedly listed as top 2026 garden trends. Brand-level demand not verified.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Local-provenance sourcing contracts with a seed grower, seasonal subscription and brand; formulation is hard to copy cheaply.
ideas.tooling_needed: None; check EU seed marketing and labelling rules

ideas.name: Dishwasher-Safe Hygiene Bird Feeder
ideas.concept: Ceramic or borosilicate and steel feeder that disassembles for full cleaning, aligned to new hygiene advice, sold with branded seed or suet refills.
ideas.target_customer: Garden bird feeders in SE and DK, mostly 40+ and gift buyers.
ideas.problem_solved: Feeders spread disease when not cleaned; advice on hygiene tightened in 2026 and most feeders are hard to clean.
ideas.trend_evidence: Garden bird feeding market forecast to grow about 5% CAGR; harvestwildlife.com reports RSPB feeding advice changed in 2026 which creates a hygiene-led opening. Search growth not verified.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Registered design for the tool-free disassembly mechanism plus refill seed lines; ornithology-group endorsement.
ideas.tooling_needed: Ceramic plaster mould or stock glass tube with custom parts, under EUR 1.5k

ideas.name: Roof-Window and Deep-Sill Cat Perch
ideas.concept: Plywood and wool-felt cat shelf engineered for deep Nordic window reveals and angled roof-window sills, with tool-free clamp mount.
ideas.target_customer: Indoor cat owners in apartments and attic flats in Sweden and Denmark.
ideas.problem_solved: Suction-cup perches fail on deep sills and sloped roof windows; cats lose a daylight spot.
ideas.trend_evidence: Europe cat segment is the fastest-growing pet category (6.8% CAGR forecast); catio and window perch products are visible on Amazon, so the base niche is already crowded. Roof-window variant demand is unverified.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Building-industry fit data for sill depths and roof-window angles; mounting design patentable or registrable.
ideas.tooling_needed: CNC/laser cut plywood and sewn felt; metal clamp via stock hardware; weight and load testing needed

ideas.name: Scent-Work Nosework Starter Kit with Natural Scent Refills
ideas.concept: Fabric hide pouches and tins plus refill scent sachets (birch, juniper) and a training card set for at-home nosework.
ideas.target_customer: Dog owners seeking mental enrichment, especially urban owners.
ideas.problem_solved: Owners want brain-tiring activities but generic snuffle mats are commoditised and give no progression.
ideas.trend_evidence: Snuffle and enrichment products are heavily covered and sold, indicating strong demand but likely crowded; nosework-specific growth is not verified, so confidence is low.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Structured training curriculum with certified trainer, branded scent refills, community challenges.
ideas.tooling_needed: None; sewn textile; check pet-safe materials and EU toy/GPSR labelling

ideas.name: Engraved Corten and Brass Plant Markers and Garden Labels
ideas.concept: Laser-engraved weathering steel and solid brass kitchen-garden markers sold as design sets, with optional custom engraving.
ideas.target_customer: Design-minded kitchen-garden and allotment owners, also gift market.
ideas.problem_solved: Plastic and wooden labels fade or rot, and do not suit the aesthetic raised-bed trend.
ideas.trend_evidence: Kitchen garden is described as becoming design-conscious with Corten raised beds in 2026 roundups. No direct search data on markers verified.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Registered designs and curated herb/vegetable icon set; personalisation builds a brand but items are copyable.
ideas.tooling_needed: Laser cutting and engraving, no mould
